download_rep_wiki_ctxt_model: download the dialogue unlikelihood context repetition model for Wizard of Wikipedia to a given datapath
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that fetches the rep_wiki_ctxt model archive using the shared build helper
review_download_function: review the download function and its delegation to the build module for model_type and version parameters
test_download_function: test the download function by calling it with a datapath and verifying the model archive is retrieved
refactor_download_function: refactor the download function to support additional model variants or version strings
